free_tier.stated: No free tier. The toy NAT line is CNY 10.00 a year for 1 core, 384 MB of memory, 1 GB of disk, LXC, a 1 Gbps port, 1 TB a month of traffic, IPv4 NAT on 20 ports and one IPv6 /128.

retention.stated: the container persists for the paid year; the page states no refund and no balance return: '不支持任何形式的退款/退余额, 以及换区'

egress.terms: 1 TB a month ('流量 1T/月'), one free traffic reset by ticket if the account has no abuse record; no overage price is printed

interface_detail: LXC container, so a root shell; the page lists no control panel beyond the WHMCS client area
tooling: any SSH client; the port block is a NAT range the vendor documents after the order
chaining: the cheapest NAT container found anywhere at USD 0.1247 a month, 384 MB and 20 ports, with 13 of 23 locations showing no out-of-stock marker

limits.value: IPv4 NAT with 20 ports on a shared address; one IPv6 /128

binding_note: 20 shared-IPv4 ports is the first hard limit: it decides whether a second service fits, and the vendor does not publish whether they are assigned or chosen.

identity_cost.detail: no card hold and no payment method is printed on the store page read; the store is a WHMCS client area with a cart and a 立即订购 button, so an account is required, but the rails are unverified

reliability_note: the vendor states the product class is unreliable in its own words: '玩具产品稳定性较差, 请不要部署生产项目' (the toy products are relatively unstable, do not deploy production projects), and abuse '将直接删除服务' (deletes the service outright)
confidence_note: price, term, shape, traffic, port count and the IPv6 /128 are quoted from the vendor's own store page read; the price is in CNY and converted at a dated rate; the port assignment rule, UDP support, the SSH port rule and the payment rails are unpublished

evidence.proved: quoted plan body: 'CPU 1C / 内存 384M / 磁盘 1GB / 虚拟化 LXC / 带宽 1G / 流量 1T/月 / IPv4 NAT(20端口) / IPv6 /128', and the English locale renders it as 'CPU 1C / Memory 384M / Storage 1G / Virtual LXC / Speed 1G / Traffic 1T/Mon / IPv4 NAT(20 ports) / IPv6 /128'
quoted price block for 玩具英国NAT1: '¥10.00CNY' then '每年' (CNY 10.00 a year); 玩具日本NAT2 and 玩具新加坡NAT1 print '¥20.00CNY / 每年'

stock markers: 10 of the 23 listed products carry '0 可用' (0 available) in their header - 玩具新加坡NAT1/2, 玩具德国NAT1/2, 玩具香港NAT1/2, 玩具荷兰NAT1, 玩具洛杉矶NAT3/4/5, 玩具日本NAT1, 玩具RN洛杉矶DC3 - while 玩具英国NAT1 carries no such marker
quoted FX table dated 'Date="24.10.2026"': 'CNY 1 12,0557' and 'USD 1 80,5381' RUB, so CNY 1 = 12.0557/80.5381 = USD 0.149689

notes: The lowest published price by a factor of four: CNY 10.00 a year is USD 1.4969 a year, USD 0.1247 a month, for 384 MB, 1 GB of disk, 20 NAT ports, an IPv6 /128 and 1 TB a month. It is also the weakest offer on every axis that is not price. The vendor calls the class '玩具' (toy) and says in the plan body not to deploy production projects on it; abuse deletes the service with no refund and no balance return. The location list is 23 SKUs and 10 of them printed '0 可用' (0 available) when read, so stock is partial rather than absent: the UK, Ireland, Los Angeles NAT1/2, Netherlands NAT2/3, Buffalo, Dallas, Toronto, Chicago and Japan NAT2 SKUs carried no out-of-stock marker. Not established: whether the 20 ports are assigned by the host or chosen by the buyer, whether SSH is one of the 20, whether UDP is forwarded, and the payment rails. The order links on the store page ('/store/toy-vps/<slug>') resolve back to the category page, so the configuration step that would print the port rule was not reachable without adding to a cart, which does not do.

extras.price_arithmetic: CNY 10.00 a year x (12.0557 RUB per CNY / 80.5381 RUB per USD) = CNY 10.00 x USD 0.149689 = USD 1.4969 a year; / 12 = USD 0.1247 a month on annual prepay. Both rates from the CBR table dated 24.10.2026. Out of pocket for the first year is USD 1.4969. A VPS bills whether it runs or not, so the 24/7 and 10 h/day figures are the same.
extras.renewal_note: one annual price is printed per SKU with no strike-through and no promo code, so CNY 10.00 is the ordinary rate; the renewal cycle is not stated separately

network_out.ports: IPv4 NAT with 20 ports on a shared address, plus one IPv6 /128
